usage_notes: Advertised-only capability layer plus read-only catalog observation; no completion probe, forwarder smoke, or deployed gateway smoke has run for this identity yet.
Per-vendor station token: this model is reachable only with its group key (scoping verified read-only 2026-08-18: each of the four tokens lists exactly one vendor, zero cross-vendor visibility).
CLAUDE token catalog (2026-08-18): 9 models from claude-haiku-4-5 through claude-opus-5/sonnet-5/fable-5.

Station WAF blocks generic Python User-Agents with Cloudflare 1010; browser-style and OpenAI-SDK-style UAs pass (verified 2026-08-18). The gateway/probe HTTP stack must be confirmed live before qualification.
Station per-token prices sit behind the console login, so no pricing file exists for this provider and ledger cost estimates are intentionally unknown (pricing_missing), never zero.
Advertised specs come from the upstream vendor official pages and are unverified for this relay (the station may cap context/output below vendor maxima).

2026-08-18 live gates: qualification recorded CANDIDATE — message/usage/exact identity passed, effort variants accepted, but no reasoning field is exposed through the station's OpenAI-compatible translation (thinking not observable; Claude thinking blocks are not mapped to reasoning_content by this relay). A profile revision for non-exposing dialects awaits separate authorization.

2026-08-18 re-qualification under explicit operator authorization (+24 completions): profile 0.1.1 relaxes enablement.required_probes from [message, thinking, usage] to [message, usage] because this relay dialect structurally cannot expose reasoning (OpenAI chat-completions has no reasoning slot; the station's /responses shim also drops reasoning items). The relaxation is auditable in the profile version bump, the alias re-binding, the CHANGELOG entry, and this note; the model still reasons (tokens fold into completion billing) — only visibility is waived, not the fact. Qualification now ENABLED with exact identity; forwarder smoke 200 observed_supported; isolated 5237 gateway smoke 200 exact identity.

2026-08-19 targeted capability verification (operator-requested; stream/tool-call/tool-replay/structured-output per model, max_tokens<=256): stream 200 with [DONE] and json_object parses; BUT native tool calling is dialect-broken at the station: the relay returns function.arguments as malformed concatenated JSON ('{}{"city": "Beijing"}') and tool-result replay messages are rejected with HTTP 400 'content: Input should be a valid list' in BOTH standard string and Anthropic-style list shapes. Agentic tool loops are unusable on this route until the station fixes its Claude translation; plain chat/stream/structured output are fine.

2026-08-19 Anthropic-native surface characterization (operator-provided endpoint from CCSwitch config, 3 authorized calls, max_tokens<=128): POST https://api.aigocode.com/v1/messages with Bearer auth works — message 200 exact identity; forced tool_use block returns NATIVE dict input (no malformed concatenated JSON, unlike the OpenAI-compat shim); tool_result replay accepted 200 and answered from the tool output. Conclusion: agent tool loops on claude-sonnet-5 are fully usable via the Anthropic-native surface (ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=https://api.aigocode.com, ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN=<claude token>); the OpenAI-compat route keeps its recorded shim defects. Earlier 502 on the same URL was resolved by request shape (Bearer-only + claude-cli style UA); a gateway anthropic_native transport would be a separate ADR project.
